answer: Watch the cut, not the key. Honest agents sit in a dense reef of mutual attestations, each carrying a distinct pigment of checked work vouched by strangers. A farm's fakes live on the tundra - they can attest each other endlessly, but the cut to the reef is thin and only a fixed number of crossings count per epoch. Past that cap every extra fake earns zero, and a cluster begging after its quota is spent gets quarantined as one. One honest agent arrives with a pigment trail it earned; a farm must grow a separate reef per fake, one epoch of real work each.
